reviews.x: I'm originally from Long Island NY and I have missed having *real* Devil Dogs! There are some made by other companies who try to compete with Drake. In my opinion, they do not compare! Being in Arizona, it's an additional bonus that these cakes are fantastic frozen! They don't fall apart and aren't too sweet with real cream filling not that nasty fake stuff 😀 Ordering was a breeze and delivery was swift, I will continue to order all my Drake treats 😀

reviews.t: Devil Dogs are 125 years old and going strong!  Delicious Devil Food cake, you can't buy these in local stores in the So
reviews.x: Drakes Cakes Devil Dogs have been around for 125 years and there is a reason - they are delicious!  Devil's Food Snacks are great for kids lunch pails. Mom always had my favorite in mine whilst I was in school.  You can't buy these in the local stores in the south - not even Walmart.  They have their store brand and Little Debbie or Sara Lee, but these taste much better. Try 'em. you'll thank me later.
Remembered these from my childhood in PA. Been in California for years. Tasted great but the recipe has changed since the last time I had them. Only complaint, had only a month til expiration.
Received my order in the mail today, I planned on giving these to my MIL for Christmas but the used best by date is January 2, 2019. Very disappointed.
Devil dogs are an old family favorite from our days in New York.  Usually they are very expensive to get here our of state.  This was a really good deal and the devil dogs are  delicious.

reviews.t: One of my favorite desserts when I was a kid thanks
reviews.x: 8 m in New Hampshire when I was a kid live in Arizona can't find them thank you
This gift was for friends who cannot buy this item where they live.

Many of the boxes were partially crushed. I am not a forensic scientist, but the shipping box was in perfect condition. Appears they were damaged prior to shipping. The expiration date was only a week after the date I received the Devil Dogs. So overall, not thrilled with the buy.

reviews.t: These Are Real- All Devil Dogs aren't the same!
reviews.x: These are the Real Deal! Dont trust those in Walmart and other places in the South. Yes, I am a Southerner but the first ones I tasted came from Jersey City and there is a BIG difference.  The ones we have here in NC contain too much sugar so I ALWAYS  order these!
No icing in some of the cakes.  If the company wants to save money then make the cakes smaller.  Smaller amounts of icing mess up the taste and they are rather crappy now.  DO NOT BUY THIS GARBAGE
Awesome, fresh, and delicious. Fast delivery!

Devil dogs. My family was so happy to her 56 devil dogs. During cvoid they were hard to find. They were fresh. Didn’t last long. Kids has them for all meals until the box was empty. I Didn’t have to cook. Would rings dings been as good ? Hell no !!! Who could live without devil dogs. Screw eating healthy. Fatten up the kids. They are annoying anyway don’t  give them milk. So they won’t be able to talk while getting down such a dry food

This is my family’s absolute favorite snack. We each eat one a day so they tend to not last long.  Every box we’ve gotten is always fresh. I can’t really comment about how long their shelf life is since we eat them too fast to find out.  Even friends and family members we don’t see often are dropping by for a devil dog 😋. These can’t be found where I live so I’m thrilled to be able to get them here.

These are great for us who grew up a long time ago eating these!! People complain that the cake is dry but that is how they have always been. The only thing that is different is the size. Like every else, it is smaller and the price is higher. But, if you ate these when you were younger, it will bring back memories!! The delivery was 4 days before the estimated delivery so kudos!

We found the package on our porch at about 2:00 PM. It is 3:30 and 2 boxes are already eaten. So good! Just like I remember. You can taste the current recipe has more high octane corn syrup, but the underlying taste, and lack of after-taste is still right where it always was. I am VERY popular right now! :-) 5 stars!

Don't get me wrong!... I absolutely love love love love devil dogs!!! It's been my ultimate favorite since I was a little girl... I'm just not too happy with the mailing service. Although amazing did the best they could have to get me my shipment... I'm forced to give a smaller review  because of it...

My Wife Devaron and I buy these of her mother Carol. We came from NY who sold them in Wal-Marts. Moved to AZ and there are none to be found so we order them from time to time to make her happy. She loves them so and we make her day! Thank you for selling them at a great price!

We used to eat devil dogs growing up in New England. We now live in AZ and cannot purchase them anywhere other than on line. We love the taste. I buy them for Christmas and give a box to my girls and grandkids. Everyone loves them.

These are still the same delicious devil dogs that I remember eating growing up in Brooklyn. I'm so so glad we can buy them here online since they aren't sold down in Texas! Don't ever stop making them Drakes!
I miss Devil Dogs and Yankee Doodles living in Los Angeles. I can finally have Devil Dogs delivered at a reasonable price. Now if they could only do the same with Yankee Doodles ... hint, hint ...
PRICE ABOUT THE SAME AS LOCALLY BOUGHT BUT CAN NOT GET IT. DELIVERY IN A WEEK AND TWO EXPIRATION DATE. KEEP THIS IN MIND WHEN YOU BUY 7 BOXES AT A TIME YOU DO NOT HAVE ALOT OF TIME TO EAT THEM.
I am so glad to receive them. A little pricey, but I'm from Pa and now live in Az. Arizona does not carry this product or Tastykakes. We Love them so much so Thank - You.
I love being able to get these seeing I can’t get them in Vegas! Delivery time is quite a while. Don’t know why they go to TN then KS all over . But worth it!

reviews.t: Devil dogs taste great even after being smashed in transit
reviews.x: devil dogs were smushed when delivered and 7 packs of 8 each were in various states of damage. About 3 of 7 cartons had to be eaten with a spoon, yummy!
Can't tell you how much I love these cakes it's such a blast from my past I have one every day with coffee takes me back to a simpler time LOL

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the Devil Dogs as delicious and a nostalgic childhood favorite, often noting they can't find them locally.
Several reviewers praise the value and fast delivery, calling it a great deal.
A recurring complaint is that the product arrived close to or past its expiration date.
Some reviewers note the recipe has changed, citing less icing or more corn syrup, and some report crushed or damaged boxes.
Multiple reviewers emphasize these are the authentic Drake's Devil Dogs, superior to competing versions found in stores.
